page_title: EIN 3-3 BAY | Eintracht Frankfurt v Bayern Munich 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner.
90+5' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
90+4' 3 - 3 Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the left post.
90' Aleksandar Pavlovic goes off the pitch and Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich) comes on.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) replaces Dayot Upamecano.
90' Substitution. Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Michael Olise walks off.
89' Rough tackle by Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
85' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up an injury.
84' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to find Junior Dina Ebimbe, but he puts too much power on the pass.
82' Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) trips an opposition player and Benjamin Brand signals a foul.
81' Referee Benjamin Brand sees the trip by Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
80' Fares Chaibi comes off the pitch to be replaced by Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt).
79' The game is interrupted now, Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
78' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
77' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
77' A corner kick by Bayern Munich is thwarted by the well prepared Kaua Santos (Eintracht Frankfurt).

77' Kaua Santos leaps like a salmon to deny Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net.
75' A substitution has been made. Ansgar Knauff goes off and Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
75' Here is a change. Hugo Larsson is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt).
72' Substitution. Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) has come on for Harry Kane.
71' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Benjamin Brand stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
69' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
66' Vincent Kompany has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) replacing Serge Gnabry.
66' Substitution. Hugo Ekitike walks off the pitch and Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.
66' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
63' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Kaua Santos easily deals with the threat.
62' Bayern Munich quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
59' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) took the corner.
56' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayern Munich.

56' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) controls the ball from the free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up in the bottom left corner but for a magnificent save by Kaua Santos.
55' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle after Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
53' 2 - 3 Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) struck from medium range. He smashed the ball inside the left post. What a hit! Pure magic.
52' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
51' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
50' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
48' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) wastes a really promising free kick position. His strike flies well wide of the right post.
46' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Benjamin Brand signals.
46' The game is over for Ellyes Skhiri. Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on for the second half.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Benjamin Brand has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

45' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Manuel Neuer!
45' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
43' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
43' Total attempts – 2:12.
38' 2 - 2 Goal 2:2! Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
38' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

35' 2 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Omar Marmoush, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt), who beats Manuel Neuer with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
34' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) tested Kaua Santos with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
31' A neat pass is well received by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
30' 27:73 – the latest ball possession ratio.
27' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

22' 1 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
22' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
21' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kaua Santos intercepts the ball.
21' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
19' A lofted cross from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
19' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
18' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
17' The free kick from long range, taken by Eintracht Frankfurt, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

15' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Thomas Muller, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich), who beats Kaua Santos with a brilliant shot into the top of the net. 0:1.
15' Bayern Munich work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
15' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the top left corner, but Kaua Santos easily deals with the threat.
13' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

10' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Kaua Santos, who pulls off a stunning save!
9' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) will deliver the corner kick.
9' A cross into the box from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is cleared.
8' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
8' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
6' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
5' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
3' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) serves up a nice cross, but Kaua Santos punches the ball away.
2' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
2' Good chance! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Bayern Munich will take the kick-off.
Benjamin Brand will referee today's match.
